Create a game sprite sheet with exactly FOUR equal cells arranged 2 columns by 2 rows, transparent background, no grid lines, text or labels. The referenced single plush toy character must be faithfully reproduced, same identity, colors, silhouette, camera, pot decoration, scale and fur detail. Each cell: full character, content x8–92%, y6–83% of cell, blank bottom17%; exact same pot position/size and head center throughout, no clipping or neighboring cell overlaps. Top left: ATTACK, eyes alert, mouth small round open as blowing a bubble; no projectile. Top right: SPENT, eyes tired droopy and tiny exhausted open mouth, head upright, no effects. Bottom left: READY, cheeks puffed and mouth puckered, attentive eyes; same body silhouette. Bottom right: BLINK, eyes fully closed softly, relaxed mouth. Never change camera or pose angle; only small facial expression changes. Preserve dense fine short plush fur, fluffy silhouette and felt flower/cloud pot, soft diffuse lighting. Clean true alpha.
